metadata.description:
Because content is the fun part.

Turn your ideas into captions and a content plan with Zova, your AI social media manager.

CREATE IN YOUR VOICE
Start with an idea, photo or video. Shape an editable caption in Studio, refine it with AI and keep the final say over your words.

FIND YOUR NEXT MOVE
Get a practical post proposal informed by your saved strategy, voice and available performance data. Explore another idea or update your strategy whenever your priorities change.

PLAN YOUR CONTENT
Keep drafts and upcoming posts together in Schedule. Use the calendar to see what is coming, edit your work and choose when it should go live.

LEARN FROM AVAILABLE RESULTS
Review the account and post metrics your connected platforms make available. Zova distinguishes missing data from measured results so you can decide what to try next.

STAY IN CONTROL
Connect eligible social accounts, review the destination, caption, media and settings, then confirm publication. AI processing is optional and can be changed in Account. Instagram connections require a Creator or Business account. Platform permissions, formats and available metrics vary.

A Zova account and internet connection are required. Current access is free: no payment card or subscription is required.

Support: support@zova-social.com

reviewer_notes_draft:
Zova Social 1.0.0 is a native SwiftUI iPhone app with Studio, Schedule, Performance and Account. The web and iPhone apps share the same Zova account and saved data. Account sign-in and social authorization temporarily use a secure system browser session and return to the app. The main interface is native, not a website wrapper.

Use the dedicated account supplied in Sign-In Information. Opening the app does not publish. You can create and edit a caption, save a draft, inspect Next move and edit strategy/voice without connecting a social account. Choose Allow AI processing if you wish to test AI features; Account lets you withdraw it. Images and sampled video frames may be shared with OpenAI after consent; video audio is not analysed. Review all AI output.

Publishing requires an eligible connected account and explicit final confirmation. Instagram requires a Creator or Business account. TikTok Direct Post is enabled for the approved production app; a private six-second test reached TikTok PUBLISH_COMPLETE on 30 October 2026. Private TikTok posts may have no public link. X depends on provider permissions and limits. Facebook Page permissions are still pending separate Meta review; do not interpret an app administrator's working Page as access for ordinary customers. This remains a release decision/blocker until resolved or clearly unavailable in the shipping interface.

Performance displays only available data; unavailable or stale data is labelled rather than fabricated. Customer charges, subscription enforcement and live Stripe checkout are disabled. There are no active in-app purchases or external purchase prompts in the iPhone app.

Account > Delete account starts deletion within the app after password confirmation. Access is closed and unsent posts are cancelled immediately; active data erasure is handled under the published deletion policy. Deleting Zova does not remove already-published social posts.
